english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a mistake or error, especially when taking blame for it.

exampleSentences.english: This time, it was my mistake.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 ci3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 co3

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for admitting fault or referring to a minor mistake.

exampleSentences.english: I really am at fault this time.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 jau5 co3

english.note: Use 錯 as the everyday noun for a mistake, including a slip of the tongue when the focus is the error.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 co3
